title: Cozy Chaos SMP
description: Hermitcraft-style vanilla+ SMP with a small, friendly 18+ community, long-term world, shopping district, and big collaborative builds with no griefing/stealing, just chill vibes and making friends!
body:
Hermitcraft-style Java SMP built for a small and friendly 18+ community that actually sticks around. It’s a long-term world with a proper shopping district, player run economy and a focus on big builds and collaborative projects! It's the kind of server where people chat, plan and end up becoming friends not just random names in the tab list.

We keep it chill and fair, no griefing, no stealing and no drama. If you’re active and enjoy building and like the idea of a server that feels like a shared world rather than a revolving door you’ll fit right in. Join via Discord and we’ll get you whitelisted!

[discord.gg/RuNzwQkng3](https://discord.gg/RuNzwQkng3)
